newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 200 MW peak firm power for Friday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 200 MW peak firm power for Friday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts of peak firm power for Friday delivery at $17.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $19.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, the agency said Thursday.
BPA continued to offer an unlimited volume of light-load firm power at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100 to 0500 and 2400 PDT on Friday were also unchanged at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 was unchanged at $10.00.
